lead.claim: Proprioceptive training may prevent ankle sprains in athletes.
lead.context: *Why this matters*: A systematic review found proprioceptive training associated with a lower relative occurrence of ankle injury in athletes.

supporting.claim: Home-based neurorehab systems can increase engagement for stroke survivors.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: A decentralized trial showed high engagement and improvements in mobility measures for chronic stroke survivors using a home-based system.

supporting.claim: Massage therapy improves pain and function in knee osteoarthritis.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: A 12-week massage RCT found greater improvements in pain and function, and reduced muscle co-contraction in medial knee OA patients compared to education.

supporting.claim: Multimorbidity and training adherence predict better outcomes in older adults.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: In older adults undergoing training, multimorbidity, younger age, lower BMI, and higher resistance training adherence predicted better responses.

supporting.claim: Ask about menopause and personalize care for women’s MSK pain.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: A qualitative study identified direct inquiry, individualized treatment, and education as facilitators for physiotherapy engagement in women with menopause-related pain.
